lastHandoff.summary: Content files are only rewritten through Node with explicit utf8; PowerShell Get-Content/Set-Content is banned for content edits.
lastHandoff.reason: Get-Content decodes UTF-8 as ANSI and Set-Content writes UTF-8-with-BOM, which corrupted em dashes into mojibake and added BOMs to three articles in b666681. The damage reached dist/ before review caught it. src/scripts/lint-encoding.mjs now fails the build on BOM, the known Windows-1252 sequences and U+FFFD.

decisions.summary: Use repository-owned project memory before adding Graphiti.
decisions.reason: The repo already contains state.json, Mission Control, SQLite SEO memory, and agent rules; a graph service would add another state store and database dependency before the handoff contract is stable.
Only one article may be made live in a session; all other article work remains draft-only until human review.
